why: A board game where nobody is a character, its settings saying the players are characters: the friend sits still at the table and nothing on the screen says what they are doing. The open question since 2026-10-05 ("each player sees the others as a character": what is that for a board?), settled by the creator on 2026-10-14 ("You can fix seeing your friend default"): with no character, each friend is shown by presence. Gate E must fail it: the board holds every player's body, so each screen must show the other's seat card, pointer and moves.
